message.content: The Declaration of Independence was **adopted on July 4, 1776**, but the formal signing of the document by the Continental Congress took place **on August 2, 1776**. The July date is the one most commonly celebrated, while August 2 marks when the signatures were actually affixed.

But historically, the Declaration was adopted July 4, 1776, but signed mostly on August 2, 1776. The question: "When was the Declaration of Independence signed?"
